text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: share of measurements at or below the quantile, minus the quantile's nominal level. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Green band: within 0.01 of nominal. Scored months October 2025 to June 2026; each fitted on earlier months.'

2025 to June 2026; each fitted on earlier months.
